foundation.body1: ENI wasn't built to launch a token. It was built to run real commercial systems at enterprise scale.
foundation.body2: Full EVM compatibility, 1-click AppChains, and native MiCA/GDPR compliance. Complete with an SDK, API suite, and governance templates from day one.
foundation.arch01Desc: Parallel computing + three-layer composite consensus (EPoS + VRF + ETurboBFT). Each AppChain independently exceeds 10,000 TPS. Cluster scale unlimited.
foundation.arch02Desc: RWA settlement, high-frequency clearing, payments, IoT event processing. Use cases ENI was designed for — not adapted to.
foundation.arch03Desc: Existing contracts migrate at zero cost. SDK, API, governance templates, and monitoring all included.
foundation.arch04Title: MiCA · GDPR · PDPO — Compliance built in
foundation.arch04Desc: Enterprise compliance ships with the chain — not retrofitted after deployment.

process.pageDesc: We qualify first. Then we build. Discover how ASEAN Labs engages with projects.
process.subtitle: ASEAN Labs doesn't take every project. We take projects we can deliver results for — and we're direct about which ones those are. If your project doesn't qualify, we tell you in the first call. We also tell you what would need to change.
process.step01Desc: We review your project — stage, product readiness, team strength, ENI fit. Clear yes or no within 48 hours.
process.step02Desc: Precise engagement definition. What we deliver, the timeline, the measurable outcomes. Nothing begins without a locked scope.
process.step03Desc: Every engagement is paid and formally contracted. KPIs agreed in writing. No handshake deals.
process.step04Desc: Dedicated team assigned. Operations start immediately. Single point of contact from day one.
process.step05Desc: We execute and report. Every metric traceable on-chain or documented. You always know what's happening.
process.standard1Desc: Every engagement is priced, scoped, and contracted. We do not work on token allocations, equity swaps, or promises of future upside. High-standard execution requires committed resources from both sides.
process.standard2Desc: We do not inflate numbers — not community sizes, not event attendance, not on-chain activity. Every figure we report is traceable or documented. Our reputation is built on this.
process.standard3Desc: A structured paid engagement covering community, operations, content, design, development, events, and regional distribution — all accountable to agreed KPIs. We reward real outcomes, not milestone submissions.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your information when you visit our website or interact with our services.
privacy.preamble: ASEAN LABS ("we", "our", or "us") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal data.
privacy.s1Intro: We may collect the following types of information:
privacy.s1Item1: Name, email address, wallet address, project details, or any information you voluntarily provide through contact forms, grant applications, or inquiries.
privacy.s1Item2: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and interaction data collected through cookies or analytics tools.
privacy.s1Item3: Public blockchain data such as wallet addresses and on-chain interactions. We do not control or store private keys.
privacy.s2Item1: Evaluate grant applications and incubator participation
privacy.s2Item2: Communicate with you regarding programs, updates, or partnerships
privacy.s2Item3: Improve website performance and user experience
privacy.s2Item4: Maintain security, compliance, and operational integrity
privacy.s2Item5: Support ecosystem growth within ASEAN LABS and ENI-related initiatives
privacy.s3Intro: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information only with:
privacy.s3Item1: Trusted partners (e.g. infrastructure providers, analytics tools)
privacy.s3Item2: Legal or regulatory authorities if required by law
privacy.s3Item3: ENI ecosystem partners only when relevant to program participation
privacy.s3Note: All shared data is handled under confidentiality and security obligations.
privacy.s4Intro: We may use cookies or similar technologies to:
privacy.s4Note: You may disable cookies via your browser settings.
privacy.s5Body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no digital system is 100% secure, especially in decentralized environments.
privacy.s6Intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.s6Item1: Access, update, or delete your personal data
privacy.s6Note: You may contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.s7Body: Our website may contain links to third-party platforms or dApps. We are not responsible for their privacy practices.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of our website indicates acceptance of the updated policy.
